declaredIntent.summary: Synchronize verified public v0.5.59 assets into repository projections and prepare only the next v0.5.60 candidate for a later exact-source publication Work Item.

authorityEvidence.scope: Synchronize only verified v0.5.59 public assets and prepare the following v0.5.60 candidate. No tag mutation, provider Release mutation, gate bypass, or blind retry is authorized.

riskAssessment.reason: Projection synchronization changes the source facts consumed by future installers and must bind only verified immutable public assets to the known v0.5.59 release.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized the full lifecycle, conditional on all fail-closed readiness, rehearsal, hosted verification, and closure checks passing.

preReviewWarnings: Download and hash the existing v0.5.59 public release assets before synchronization; do not create a tag or provider Release in this Work Item.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record release evidence custody before and after the provider operation.

acceptance: Downloaded v0.5.59 release.json and release-digests.json match their provider asset SHA-256 values and the v0.5.59 tag target.
The authoritative synchronization command advances source projections to published v0.5.59 and next candidate v0.5.60 without a provider tag or Release mutation.

guidelines: Use the authoritative projection synchronization command and verified provider assets; never create tags or Releases manually.
Preserve the future readiness → same-SHA rehearsal → actual release order and fail closed on any identity mismatch.
Report provider evidence and residual limitations truthfully; a successful local assertion is not publication proof.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized completion, PR merge, cleanup, and new-version publication. Restricted writes are limited to source projection synchronization, this Work Item evidence, and its PR lifecycle.

rollbackNote: Do not alter the immutable v0.5.59 provider artifacts. If synchronization fails, preserve evidence and correct source projections through a successor Work Item.

intent.problem: The evidence-based operation-impact enhancement merged as PR #818 after v0.5.59 had already been published. Repository projections were not synchronized after that publication and incorrectly present the occupied v0.5.59 tag as the next candidate.
constraints: Synchronize only the verified existing v0.5.59 public assets.
Prepare v0.5.60 but do not publish it in this Work Item.
Do not bypass asset digests, source identity, or the later rehearsal/release procedure.
intent.rationale: Synchronizing existing provider facts first makes the next release candidate unambiguous and prevents accidental tag reuse before the separate public-release lifecycle.
